issue.notes:
Found during declarative-config ArgoCD triage (declarat-26bb9df2), 2026-08-20.

Live state on ardenone-cluster:
- ExternalSecret miroir-keys (ns miroir) and miroir-dev-keys (ns miroir-dev) both fail forever with 'could not get secret data from provider'. ESO controller error: error processing spec.data[0] (key: ardenone-cluster/miroir/keys), err: Secret does not exist. ClusterSecretStore 'openbao' points at http://openbao-ardenone-cluster.openbao.svc.cluster.local:8200 (the authoritative instance for secret/ardenone-cluster/*).
- One-shot setup Pod miroir-token-generator (ns openbao, manifest in declarative-config k8s/ardenone-cluster/openbao/) fails at Kubernetes auth: invalid role name 'openbao-ardenone-cluster' — the auth/kubernetes role was never created, so the token miroir needs to write its keys was never minted.

To finish provisioning (on the ardenone-cluster OpenBao instance):
1. Create auth/kubernetes role 'openbao-ardenone-cluster' bound to SA openbao-ardenone-cluster / ns openbao with miroir-write-policy.
2. Ensure miroir-write-policy exists and grants kv write to secret/ardenone-cluster/miroir/*.
3. Write masterKey/nodeMasterKey/adminApiKey to secret/ardenone-cluster/miroir/keys (and the miroir-dev equivalent), or run miroir's own setup with the minted token.

declarative-config side: miroir-token-generator pod manifest disabled; ExternalSecrets left in place so they converge the moment the KV paths exist.
